name: e2e-v2
description: v2 end-to-end check in the real window against an empty data folder (set BAYTAR_DATA_DIR). Legacy import with E.164 phones, idempotent re-import, built-in catalog, vaccination give + plan, billing, inventory FEFO, reminders, reports, and screenshots of every v2 screen. The legacy path must point to a synthetic file from make-legacy-db.py.

steps.expr: window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke('owners_list', { query: { includeDeleted: false, limit: 50, offset: 0 } }).then(o => o.map(x => [x.fullName, x.phone]).sort())

Promise.all([window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke('vaccine_types_list', {}), window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke('medications_list', {}), window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke('services_list', { includeDeleted: false })]).then(([v, m, s]) => v.length >= 30 && m.length >= 100 && s.length >= 25 && v.every(x => !['cattle','sheep','goat','horse'].includes(x.species)))

(async () => { const inv = window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke; const owners = await inv('owners_list', { query: { includeDeleted: false, limit: 50, offset: 0 } }); const o = owners.find(x => x.fullName === 'Deneme Yılmaz'); const pets = await inv('patients_by_owner', { ownerId: o.id }); const pet = pets.find(p => p.species === 'dog' || p.species === 'cat') ?? pets[0]; const types = await inv('vaccine_types_list', {}); const rabies = types.find(t => /Kuduz/i.test(t.name)); window.__e2e = { ownerId: o.id, patientId: pet.id, rabiesId: rabies.id }; return !!rabies; })()

(async () => { const inv = window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke; const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('sv-SE'); const s = await inv('vaccines_suggest', { patientId: window.__e2e.patientId, typeId: window.__e2e.rabiesId, givenOn: today }); return typeof s === 'string' || s === null || typeof s === 'object'; })()

(async () => { const inv = window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke; const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('sv-SE'); const c = await inv('charge_create', { input: { ownerId: window.__e2e.ownerId, patientId: window.__e2e.patientId, visitId: null, serviceId: null, inventoryItemId: null, description: 'E2E muayene', quantity: 1, unitPriceMinor: 150000, discountMinor: 0, vatRate: null, chargedOn: today, notes: null } }); await inv('payment_create', { input: { ownerId: window.__e2e.ownerId, paidOn: today, amountMinor: 50000, method: 'cash', notes: null } }); return [c.totalMinor, await inv('account_balance', { ownerId: window.__e2e.ownerId })]; })()

(async () => { const inv = window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke; const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('sv-SE'); const r = await inv('reports_overview', { from: today.slice(0, 8) + '01', to: today, today }); const m = r.months.find(x => x.month === today.slice(0, 7)); return [m.revenueMinor, m.collectionsMinor]; })()

(async () => { const inv = window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke; const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('sv-SE'); const r = await inv('reminders_overview', { query: { today, vaccineDays: 7, debtDays: 30, followupDays: 7 } }); return Array.isArray(r.vaccines) && Array.isArray(r.debts); })()
